references.text: The parable of the talents reflects the idea of using what one has been given instead of hiding it away, as expressed in Psalms.
Proverbs warns against laziness and encourages diligence, which can be seen in connection with the servant's actions in the parable.
The parable of the treasure in the field emphasizes the value of God's kingdom and acting on opportunities, in contrast to the servant's fear-based inactivity.
The parable of the minas in Luke has parallels to the parable of the talents, focusing on being faithful with what one is entrusted.
